tips.label: 單數與複數
tips.text: 一個可數物品用單數名詞；兩個以上用複數名詞。一般加 -s，部分字尾加 -es 或有不規則變化。

tips.label: 遠近指示詞
tips.text: 近處單數用 this、遠處單數用 that；近處複數用 these、遠處複數用 those。回答時分別用 it 或 they。

tips.label: What 問物品
tips.text: 單數用 What is this/that/it?；複數用 What are these/those/they?。

tips.label: 所有格
tips.text: 人稱所有格放在名詞前；單數名詞通常加 's，以 s 結尾的複數名詞只加 '。

notes.title: 可數名詞的單複數
notes.rule: a/an + 單數名詞；數字、these、those + 複數名詞
notes.description: 一般名詞加 -s；字尾為 -ch、-s、-x、-sh 時加 -es；子音加 y 時去 y 加 -ies；部分 -f 或 -fe 字尾改為 -ves。sheep、mouse、ox、person 等有特殊變化。
examples: This is a fox. Those are foxes.
One mouse is here, and two mice are there.

notes.title: 以 What 詢問物品
notes.description: 不知道物品是什麼時用 What 詢問。單數主詞搭配 is，並以 it 回答；複數主詞搭配 are，並以 they 回答。
examples: What is this? It is a picture.
What are those? They are zebras.

notes.title: be 動詞 Yes／No 問答
notes.rule: Is + 單數主詞...?／Are + 複數主詞...?
notes.description: 把 be 動詞移到主詞前形成問句。單數簡答用 Yes, it is. 或 No, it isn't.；複數簡答用 Yes, they are. 或 No, they aren't.。
examples: Is that a tiger? Yes, it is.
Are these goats? No, they aren't.

notes.title: this、that、these、those
notes.rule: this/these 表近處；that/those 表遠處
notes.description: this 與 that 後接單數名詞，these 與 those 後接複數名詞。指示代名詞需同時配合距離和單複數。

notes.title: 人稱代名詞所有格
notes.description: 所有格放在名詞前表示擁有者，後面必須接名詞，而且不可再和 a、an、the 或指示詞一起使用。

notes.title: 名詞所有格
notes.rule: 單數名詞 + 's；以 s 結尾的複數名詞 + '；不以 s 結尾的複數名詞 + 's
notes.description: 兩人共同擁有一物時只在第二個名字後加 's；兩人分別擁有時，兩個名字都加 's。
examples: Andy and Helen's house is big.
Amy's and Mia's children are cute.

quiz.question: There is one monkey here and two ___ there.
quiz.hint: monkey 的字尾 y 前是母音 e，所以複數直接加 -s，成為 monkeys。

quiz.question: One fox is near me, and three ___ are near the tree.
quiz.hint: fox 以 -x 結尾，複數要加 -es，成為 foxes。

quiz.question: That rabbit has two cute ___.
quiz.hint: baby 的字尾是子音加 y，複數要去 y 加 -ies。

quiz.question: There are two ___ on the table.
quiz.hint: knife 的複數是不規則變化：去 -fe 加 -ves，成為 knives。

quiz.question: One sheep is white, and the other three ___ are black.
quiz.hint: sheep 的單數與複數同形，不能加 -s。

quiz.question: A mouse is small, but these ___ are smaller.
quiz.hint: mouse 的不規則複數是 mice。

quiz.question: One person is inside, and five ___ are outside.
quiz.hint: person 常用的複數是 people。

quiz.question: That is one ox, and those are two ___.
quiz.hint: ox 的不規則複數是 oxen。

quiz.question: ___ is this? It is a picture.
quiz.hint: 詢問非人的物品是什麼時，用疑問詞 What。

quiz.question: What ___ those near the movie theater?
quiz.hint: those 是複數主詞，be 動詞要用 are。

quiz.question: What are these? ___ are animal signs.
quiz.hint: 複數的 these 在回答中用代名詞 they 代替。

quiz.question: What is that? ___ is a Chinese dragon.
quiz.hint: 單數的 that 在回答中用代名詞 it 代替。

quiz.question: ___ pictures in my hands are very different.
quiz.hint: pictures 是複數，而且物品在說話者手中，應用近距離複數 These。

quiz.question: What is ___ animal far from us?
quiz.hint: animal 是單數且離說話者較遠，所以用 that。

quiz.question: Is this a tiger? — ___.
quiz.hint: this 的單數 Yes 簡答用 Yes, it is.。

quiz.question: Is that a snake? — ___. It is a rope.
quiz.hint: that 的單數否定簡答用 No, it isn't.。

quiz.question: ___ these your rabbits?
quiz.hint: these 是複數主詞，Yes／No 問句要以 Are 開頭。

quiz.question: Are those zebras? — Yes, ___.
quiz.hint: those 是複數，肯定簡答用 Yes, they are.。

quiz.question: These ___ not their pictures.
quiz.hint: These 是複數主詞，否定句用 are not。

quiz.question: Are those mice? — No, ___. They are rats.
quiz.hint: 複數否定簡答用 No, they aren't.。

quiz.question: ___ that an elephant in the picture?
quiz.hint: that 是單數主詞，問句要以 Is 開頭。

quiz.question: Is that ___?
quiz.hint: elephant 是單數可數名詞，且以母音音素開頭，前面用 an。

quiz.question: Those are ___ books, not our books.
quiz.hint: books 前要用形容詞性所有格 their。

quiz.question: I am Ivan, and this is ___ picture.
quiz.hint: 主詞是 I，放在名詞 picture 前的所有格是 my。

quiz.question: He has a rooster. It is ___ rooster.
quiz.hint: he 的形容詞性所有格是 his，放在名詞 rooster 前。

quiz.question: Amy has a rabbit. It is ___ rabbit.
quiz.hint: she 的形容詞性所有格是 her。

quiz.question: We have two goats. They are ___ goats.
quiz.hint: we 的形容詞性所有格是 our，放在 goats 前。

quiz.question: The tiger has a long tail. ___ tail is strong.
quiz.hint: 表示「牠的尾巴」要用所有格 Its；It's 是 It is 的縮寫。

quiz.question: That horse belongs to Peter. It is ___ horse.
quiz.hint: 單數人名 Peter 的所有格加 's，成為 Peter's。

quiz.question: The mother of the puppies is here. She is the ___ mother.
quiz.hint: puppies 是以 s 結尾的複數名詞，所有格只在字尾加 '。

quiz.question: These pictures belong to the children. They are the ___ pictures.
quiz.hint: children 是不以 s 結尾的複數名詞，所有格加 's。

quiz.question: Andy and Helen share one house. It is ___ house.
quiz.hint: 兩人共同擁有一間房子時，只在第二個名字後加 's。

quiz.question: Amy and Mia each have children. They are ___ children.
quiz.hint: 兩人分別擁有時，兩個名字都要加 's。

quiz.question: Which noun phrase is correct?
quiz.hint: 名詞所有格 Sam's 已限定 hat，不可再加 the、a 或 this。

quiz.question: John and Mary each have a picture. These are ___ pictures.
quiz.hint: John 與 Mary 分別擁有圖片，因此兩個名字都加 's。

quiz.question: The books belong to the girls. They are ___ books.
quiz.hint: girls 是以 s 結尾的複數名詞，所有格只加 '。

quiz.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: B. This is the my picture.
C. This is a my picture.
D. This is this my picture.
quiz.hint: 所有格 my 已限定 picture，前面不能再加 the、a 或 this。

quiz.question: Choose the correct phrase for a hat belonging to Sam.
quiz.hint: 單數人名的所有格是 Sam's，直接放在名詞 hat 前。

quiz.question: ___ are zebras near us.
quiz.hint: zebras 是複數，且在近處，所以用 These。

quiz.question: ___ are oxen far from us.
quiz.hint: oxen 是複數，且在遠處，所以用 Those。

quiz.question: This is one picture, and those are three ___.
quiz.hint: picture 的複數是直接加 -s，成為 pictures。

quiz.question: One watch is small, but those two ___ are big.
quiz.hint: watch 以 -ch 結尾，複數要加 -es。

quiz.question: What ___ these animals?
quiz.hint: these animals 是複數主詞，be 動詞要用 are。

quiz.question: What ___ this sign?
quiz.hint: this sign 是單數主詞，be 動詞要用 is。

quiz.question: ___ those your Chinese pictures?
quiz.hint: those pictures 是複數主詞，問句以 Are 開頭。

quiz.question: Is this your animal sign? — Yes, ___ is.
quiz.hint: this 的單數簡答要用代名詞 it。

quiz.question: Are those their horses? — Yes, ___ are.
quiz.hint: those 的複數簡答要用代名詞 they。

quiz.question: That is ___ energetic monkey.
quiz.hint: energetic 以母音音素開頭，單數可數名詞 monkey 前用 an。

quiz.question: ___ animals beside me are very smart.
quiz.hint: animals 是複數且在說話者旁邊，所以用 These。

quiz.question: The people have pictures. These are ___ pictures.
quiz.hint: pictures 前需要形容詞性所有格 their。
